DZ-SS14/001EN
Dragonic Overlord
Normal Unit｜ Dragon Empire｜ Grade 3｜ Power 13000｜ Shield
[CONT]:The normal ride of this card from a grade 3 card with a Kai icon and a different card name from this card also becomes a persona ride.
[AUTO](VC)[1/Turn]:At the end of the battle this unit attacked, [COST][Counter-Blast 1], [Stand] this unit, and until end of turn, it gets drive -1. If you persona rode this turn, [COST][put a card from hand into soul], until end of turn, this unit gets drive +1, and all of your front row units get [Power]+5000.
[AUTO](RC)[1/Turn]:At the end of the battle this unit attacked a rear-guard, if you have a vanguard with a Kai icon, [COST][Energy-Blast 3], and [Stand] this unit.

DZ-SS14/002EN
Dragon Knight, Nehalem
Normal Unit｜ Dragon Empire｜ Grade 2｜ Power 10000｜ Shield 5000
[AUTO]:When this unit is placed on (VC), look at the top seven cards of your deck, choose up to one non-sentinel unit card with a Kai icon from among them, reveal it and put it into hand, and shuffle the deck. If this unit was placed from hand, this unit gets [Power]+5000 until end of turn.
[AUTO](Drop):When your grade 3 or greater vanguard with a Kai icon is placed, perform one of the following.
・If you do not have a rear-guard with the same card name as this card, you may call this card to (RC). If you called a card, your vanguard and this unit get [Power]+5000 until end of turn.
・[COST][Bind this card], choose one of your vanguard's [AUTO] abilties, and reduce its next [Counter-Blast] cost you pay by ① until end of turn.
